findings.evidence: no visible focus indicator (outline: none 2px oklab(0.488 -0.0238138 -0.24183 / 0.5))
findings.after: Add :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid; outline-offset: 2px } in a colour at 3:1 against the ground.
findings.title: Visible focus everywhere
findings.fix: Use :focus-visible with a 2px ring offset 2px in a contrasting colour.

findings.evidence: button[type=submit] has no accessible name
findings.title: Controls have accessible names
findings.fix: Add visible text or aria-label.

findings.evidence: declared "Share Tech Mono" but Consolas drew the text
findings.after: Fix the font load (path, format, font-display) or declare the face you actually ship.
findings.title: The intended font actually renders
findings.fix: Fix the font load (path, format, font-display) and wait for fonts before capture.

findings.evidence: zoom disabled (maximum-scale=1 blocks zoom): width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0,maximum-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover
findings.title: Zoom never blocked
findings.fix: Remove the restriction.

findings.evidence: input[type=text] has no label (placeholder "Search games..." is not a label)
findings.title: Form fields have labels
findings.fix: Add a visible label element.

findings.evidence: Tab order: search -> header buttons -> footer links 'TOS/EULA', 'Privacy', 'Upload a Game' (y 868) -> 'Enter Fullscreen' (y 16) -> Like / Follow / PLAY (y 540-600) -> FILTER dock. Focus jumps bottom-to-top before reaching the main action.
findings.before: Footer links and fullscreen button precede main content in DOM order
findings.after: Reorder DOM so header -> game info and actions -> carousel -> footer; put 'Enter Fullscreen' in the header group
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.3 Focus Order and 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence.
findings.title: Headings and landmarks
findings.fix: Fix levels in markup and size with CSS.

findings.where: full-bleed background scene and theme audio
findings.evidence: Background is an animated game scene (transition-all 1s layers) and the page requests 'ps5_theme_*.mp3' (manifest network). A speaker icon button (x 1230) has no accessible name (sweep). No visible pause for the motion.
findings.before: Auto background motion and theme audio, unnamed mute toggle
findings.after: Do not autoplay audio; give the toggle aria-label="Mute music" with aria-pressed; add a pause for the background and honour prefers-reduced-motion
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.2 Audio Control and 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide.
findings.title: Reduced motion respected
findings.fix: Wrap movement in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) or add a reduce override.

findings.evidence: The selected cover is shown only by a cyan glow ring (1440 tile 00) with no text or aria-current; 'NEW GAME' vs 'COMING SOON' are distinguished by yellow vs teal badge colour as well as text (text present, fine).
findings.before: Selected card indicated by colour ring only
findings.after: aria-current="true" (or aria-selected in a listbox) on the selected cover and a non-colour cue such as scale plus outline thickness
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.1 Use of Color and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value for the selection state.
findings.title: Target size
findings.fix: Enlarge the hit area with padding or a pseudo-element.

findings.evidence: touch target 36x36px at 375px (min 44px)
findings.title: Target size
findings.fix: Enlarge the hit area with padding or a pseudo-element.

findings.evidence: image is 519px wide but shown at 43px
findings.title: Performance budget
findings.fix: Compress, size and lazy-load images; preload the LCP asset.

findings.evidence: "transition-property: all": transition all animates layout and paint properties
findings.after: List the properties: transition: transform 160ms, opacity 160ms
findings.title: Motion CSS hygiene
findings.fix: List properties; use transform; one non-overshoot curve.

findings.evidence: 5 containers share radius 8.4px and shadow "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0"
findings.title: No uniform card kit
findings.fix: Remove boxes where whitespace groups; keep one card style for things that are objects.

findings.title: Sizes on a declared ladder
findings.fix: Collapse sizes to the scale; drop the extra family.

findings.evidence: "New Game" repeated 5 times in one container
findings.title: No repeated labels inside a card
findings.fix: Say it once.

findings.evidence: 62% of text is hidden after load and scrolling (max 30%; menus and dialogs excluded)
findings.title: Content never depends on animation to appear
findings.fix: Start visible; animate from visible.

findings.evidence: 122 words shown at 1440px are hidden at 375px (48 elements)
findings.title: Phone parity
findings.fix: Reflow instead of hiding.

findings.evidence: Cover alts are the title in caps ('XONOTIC', 'DARK', 'BLACK JACK') and the hero logo is also alt 'XONOTIC' next to the same title; the ESRB plate alt 'ESRB Teen' omits the 'Violence' descriptor shown beside it (that text is present, so acceptable).
findings.before: alt="XONOTIC" on both logo and cover
findings.after: Logo: alt="Xonotic" once (h1); covers: alt="" when the card also has a visible or labelled title, otherwise alt="Xonotic cover"
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: all-caps alt is read letter-by-letter by some screen readers and duplicates adjacent text.
findings.title: Images have text alternatives
findings.fix: Write what the image tells the reader, or alt="" if it tells nothing.

findings.where: hero info block over carousel, 1440 tile 00
findings.evidence: At 1440 the cover carousel sits on top of the 'PLAY' and 'ADD TO CART — $0.49' buttons, the 'FEATURED GAMES' label overprints 'Follow game', and 'Enter Fullscreen' overprints 'Install App'. The layout was not checked at this width.
findings.after: Reserve the carousel's height below the action row (e.g. grid rows: info / actions / carousel) so nothing overlaps at 1280-1440
findings.why: Unreviewed overlap is the signature of generated output shipped without a look; it also hides the main CTA.
findings.title: Look-family cluster
findings.fix: Break the family on its strongest tell first; name the replacement decision.

findings.evidence: Failed T-FRESH-READER: "Experience intense multiplayer combat with a variety of weapons, power-ups, and game modes", "delivers classic arena shooter gameplay with modern graphics and responsive controls", "Refine the catalog without leaving the action."
findings.before: "Experience intense multiplayer combat with a variety of weapons, power-ups, and game modes."
findings.after: Concrete facts: [DATA NEEDED: modes, player count, what runs in-browser and how long it takes to load]
findings.why: Store-blurb filler that would fit any shooter page.
findings.title: No slop diction
findings.fix: Replace with a specific claim only this business can make, or delete.

findings.evidence: "made with ♥ by Alex St. Louis for gamers everywhere" set in mono with a multi-stop gradient fill (sweep gradient hit) and purple heart.
findings.after: Plain text credit in the UI face, or remove
findings.why: 'Made with love' gradient credit line is a vibe-coded template residue; deleting it loses nothing (T-DELETION).
findings.title: No glow halos or radial spotlights
findings.fix: Remove; use type size and spacing for emphasis.

findings.evidence: Five consecutive covers badged 'NEW GAME' (sweep repeated_label) including Xonotic (2011) and The Simpsons: Hit & Run; badges carry no information.
findings.after: Badge only what is actually new this week, with a date, or drop the badge
findings.why: A label on everything is a label on nothing; misleading 'new' on a 2011 game.
findings.title: No invented metrics
findings.fix: Use the real number, a visible [DATA NEEDED] slot, or nothing.

findings.evidence: 138 words on one 900px screen (warn > 120)
findings.title: Words per screen within budget
findings.fix: Cut qualifiers and repeated claims; move detail to a page that is for reading.
